g.text: Greedy and coherent: places the formation card
that most improves one formation, plays other
special cards only when it cannot, claims every
Stone it can and draws Clan cards first.
One-ply look-ahead: simulates every legal play
with the real engine and scores the position with
five-Stone race, claims). Special cards carry an
Copy of the game in which the opponent's hand
and the deck order are replaced by a random
a strategy cannot see hidden information.
